name: Iinan (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Iinan town emblem in blue: a stylised human figure of a ring, a loop and a disc.
history: Municipal flag of Iinan, a town in Shimane Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 21 January 2005.

features.role: Iinan town emblem — a stylised human figure of a ring, a loop and a disc
